cells.terminal_only: each cell's terminal attempt (D11.3: the first with a completed model exit); infrastructure attempts are not checked or counted

appended_iff_event.description: appended is true iff exactly one final_turn_notice event exists; the event agrees with the receipt and comes right before the call-7 context_accounting

config_receipts.description: result.json config and the episode_setup event's config are the policy's record

delivered_iff_exchange.description: delivered is true iff exactly one model_exchange exists at call_index 7; sent equals delivered (a sent, undelivered request is InfraInterrupted, never terminal); delivered implies appended

final_response_recorded.description: each delivered final response has exactly one parsed_actions or format_error event at call_index 7

notice_receipts.description: result.json exposure.final_turn_notice equals accounting.final_turn_notice and the episode_finished event's, has exactly the receipt fields, the policy, the sha256 of its text and suffix and call_index 7, and appended_to is set exactly when appended

receipt_accounting.description: prompt_tokens is the call-7 preflight count when appended (else null), max_tokens the call-7 max_tokens when sent (else null); a notice appended but not sent ends the episode as ContextLimit at call_index 7

records.description: each terminal attempt: its directory names its cell and attempt, result.json binds attempt_start.json and events.jsonl (sha256 and rows), its run_id is run.json's, and no attempt follows it

rendering.description: the detokenized served prompt of each delivered 8th request (response.prompt_token_ids) has '[harness notice] ' + TEXT exactly once, at the end of the last tool response or of the format-error user turn

request_bytes.description: the delivered 8th request: its last message is the noticed one (a tool message with the receipt's tool_call_id, or the format-error user message after an assistant message), its content ends with the suffix and matches the event's sha256s, and '[harness notice]' occurs once in the request

run_complete.description: every block-P seed-11 cell of cells.jsonl is terminal in the D11.3 sense (a completed attempt, or missing after 3 infrastructure attempts)

run_json_cells.description: cells.jsonl is the file run.json binds (cells_sha256)

run_json_episode_config.description: run.json episode_config is the policy's exact record (the six prereg fields, final_turn_policy and final_turn_notice)

selection.description: every dispatched cell is a block-P seed-11 cell of cells.jsonl

go_rule.rule: at least 90% of the final responses that received the notice (terminal attempts with a model_exchange at call_index 7) are valid tool calls (parsed_actions, not format_error, at call_index 7)

notice.format_error_note: appended_to format_error: the notice went on the format-error message after a format error at response 7 (REMINDER_FEASIBILITY.md section 2.5); reported per policy (A1 review, finding 2), not gated
